Container.Name: NYC Trash Map
Container.Overview: Interactive map of New York City trash, recycling, organics, and bulk-item collection schedules by street and day.
Container.Description: Explore NYC sanitation collection schedules on an interactive street map. NYC Trash Map periodically downloads official NYC data, validates and processes it, and stores generated map data in a persistent application-data directory.
Container.Requires: The first data refresh may take some time. Live browser location requires HTTPS or localhost. New installations must begin with an empty application-data directory.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persistent generated map data. New installations must begin with an empty directory.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port used to access NYC Trash Map.

Config.Name: Application Environment
Config.Description: Runs the application in production mode.

Config.Name: Enable Automatic Refresh
Config.Description: Run the automatic background data-refresh scheduler.

Config.Name: Refresh on Startup
Config.Description: Check for and process updated NYC data when the container starts.

Config.Name: Refresh Interval (Days)
Config.Description: Number of days between successful automatic refresh attempts.

Config.Name: Refresh Failure Retry (Minutes)
Config.Description: Minutes to wait before retrying a failed data refresh.

Config.Name: Retained Data Releases
Config.Description: Number of validated data releases retained on the persistent volume.

Config.Name: Application Title
Config.Description: Visible and accessible heading displayed above the map.

Config.Name: Application Subtitle
Config.Default: See collection schedules by street and day.
Config.Description: Subtitle displayed below the map heading.

Container.Config: See collection schedules by street and day.

Config.Name: Browser Title
Config.Description: Title used for browser tabs, search results, and social previews.

Config.Name: Application Short Name
Config.Description: Short label used when the application is installed on a device.

Config.Name: Meta Description
Config.Default: Explore NYC sanitation schedules by street and day. View trash, recycling, organics, and bulk collection near your live location on an interactive map.
Config.Description: Description used by search engines and social previews.

Container.Config: Explore NYC sanitation schedules by street and day. View trash, recycling, organics, and bulk collection near your live location on an interactive map.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Public HTTPS origin without a trailing slash, such as https://example.com. Used for canonical URLs, social previews, sitemap.xml, and structured metadata.

Config.Name: Robots.txt Policy
Config.Description: Complete robots.txt contents using literal \n separators. An empty value blocks web crawlers by default.
